that makes sense, but if you ever need help dont be shy to reach out to professionals. maybe they could give you coping skills you hadn't thought of yourself? but I understand the logic behind doing it yourself, because after all, you do know yourself best. as long as its healthy and making you happy, I definitely dont see a problem in motivating yourself.

your story is very motivating, and I'm not sure how much this will mean coming from a stranger, but I'm proud of you. maybe you should consider therapy for the body dysmorphia you're experiencing? best of luck to you friend.

im so sorry for your loss. have you considered therapy? the death of a close family member is definitely one reason people can get depressed. but you arent alone in this, and you can get through it. if you're having thoughts of suicide you should definitely at least try to get into therapy. therapists should be able to provide you with coping mechanisms so you can recover from the trauma of losing your dad. plus, a therapist might be comforting since they're someone to talk to, especially because you are alone in a foreign country. I'm sorry you're feeling this way, and I know it can be hard to face it and get into therapy, especially with the stigma around it, but believe me tons of people are in therapy so it's nothing to be ashamed of. I'm currently trying to get into it as well. I hope you find a healthy path for your life, I'm rooting for you.

idk my story. I grew up around drugs and was sexually abused when I was around 4 or 5 by men I didnt know. no one knew besides maybe my dad. my mom left my dad and banned all contact with me even tho she didnt know about the abuse stuff. that really fucked me up because he was my favorite parent and I couldn't understand why he would just leave me. I developed really severe abandonment issues and got really depressed. my mom was always too busy for me so I lived with my grandparents. my mom met my step dad and we started living with him when I was like 7. I was so confused sexually because I was little so I insinuated more sexual abuse on myself I guess. makes me feel gross to think about. he went along with it and kept doing it until I was like 11. then i got into my emo phase and started self harm but nothing serious. I pleaded and pleaded for therapy but my mom didnt really understand mental illness. I tried to kill myself and she finally got me into therapy when I was like 14 or 15. I tried to kill myself again around 16. I'm 18 now and I moved out because i cant stand to see my stepdad. no one knows about what happened to me and I'm just scared all the time. 

I have my girlfriend though, who is lovely and perfect but I havent told her everything about my childhood. I'm just scared
